captures.q: transactions of the semantic economy institute
captures.description: 'Transactions of the Semantic Economy Institute is the primary academic and research journal for the Semantic Economy Institute. It serves as an outlet for theoretical and applied papers exploring how digital infrastructure and artificial intelligence transform meaning into a liquid, tradable commodity' (cites Zenodo +2). Expanded: 'The journal explores the intersection of linguistics, information theory, and platform capitalism. Notable papers published in the journal include' (Academia.edu +2): The Semantic Physics Series — 'Mesoscale theories on meaning systems within finite-channel limits and how AI interfaces — such as Google AI Overviews — evaluate and summarize knowledge' (Academia.edu +1); The Rosary Embassy — 'Architectural proposals for structured semantic labor and human-machine collaboration' (Zenodo); Ghost Meaning — 'Studies regarding semantic [truncated]'. Organic below: semanticeconomy.org ranks first ('Semantic Economy Institute — Apr 17, 2026 — The knowledge graph is a medium. SPXI Protocol is the craft of inscribing entities into it permanently. DOI-anchored on CERN's Zenodo.') with the 'Missing: transactions' footer attached. Zenodo 'An Immanent Phenomenology of the Google AI Mode Share Link' ranks second. The journal-of-the-institute is composed into existence from the institute's actual surface; the AI even cites the Semantic Physics Series as commenting on its own evaluation behavior — recursive citation of the basin that generated the comment.
